Policies

Shipping

Last updated October 7, 2026

Where we ship

We ship within the United States only for now. We can't ship to addresses outside the U.S. yet.

Shipping cost

Shipping is free on orders over $50. For smaller orders, the shipping cost is shown at checkout before you pay.

Processing and tracking

We pack orders as fast as we can. Once your order ships, we'll email you a tracking link.

Heat and delivery

ShawtyPop is candy, so hot weather can affect it in transit. Bring your package inside soon after it arrives.

Lost or damaged packages

If your package is lost or arrives damaged, see our Returns policy and we'll help.

Questions

Email us at getshawtypop@gmail.com or use our contact form.

Policies

Returns

Last updated October 7, 2026

All sales are final

Because ShawtyPop is a food product, we can't accept returns or exchanges once an order ships.

Damaged or wrong orders

If your order arrives damaged, melted or wrong, email us within 7 days of delivery with your order details and a photo. We'll send a replacement or a refund, our choice.

Lost packages

If tracking shows your package delivered but you can't find it, contact us within 7 days and we'll look into it with the carrier.

Order changes and cancellations

Need to change or cancel? Contact us right away. Once an order ships, it can't be changed or canceled.

Questions

Privacy

Last updated October 7, 2026

This policy explains what information ShawtyPop ("we", "us") collects on shawtypop.com and how we use it.

What we collect

  • Your email address and first name when you join our waitlist or the Pop Culture newsletter.
  • Your name, email and message when you use our contact form.
  • Your bag contents and a few site preferences, saved only in your own browser (local storage).
  • Basic technical data our hosting provider records automatically, like IP address and browser type, to run and protect the site.

How we use it

  • To send you the newsletter, waitlist updates, launch news and offers you signed up for.
  • To answer your messages.
  • To run, secure and improve the site.

Who we share it with

We don't sell your personal information. We use a few service providers to run the site: MailerLite (email newsletter), Google (a backup list of signups), FormSubmit (contact form delivery) and Cloudflare (hosting). They handle your information only to provide those services to us.

Your choices

Every email we send has an unsubscribe link. You can also ask us to see, correct or delete your information at any time.

Kids

Our site isn't meant for children under 13, and we don't knowingly collect their information.

Changes

If we update this policy, we'll change the date at the top of this page.

Contact

Email us at getshawtypop@gmail.com or use our contact form.

Help

FAQs.

Everything you want to know about Cherry Gloss.

What does L-Theanine do?

L-Theanine is an amino acid found naturally in tea leaves. We pair it with caffeine so the lift feels smooth and focused. That is our formula: caffeine for the energy, L-Theanine for the focus.

Why caffeine + L-Theanine?

Caffeine + L-Theanine = Energy + Focus. Together they give you the lift without the jittery, crashy feeling. No jitters. No bloat. No crash. Just pop.

Where are the lollipops made?

Every ShawtyPop is made in the USA.

Do you use artificial colors?

No. That Cherry Gloss shine comes from natural colors.

What flavors are there?

One: Cherry Gloss. Glossy, bright and made to match every outfit.

What comes in each pack?

Single (1 pop) $2.99, 5 Pack $9.99 and 12 Pack $19.99. Every pop is the same Cherry Gloss lollipop on a pink ShawtyPop stick.

Who shouldn't have ShawtyPop?

ShawtyPop contains caffeine. It is not recommended for children, anyone sensitive to caffeine, or anyone who is pregnant or nursing. Talk to your doctor if you're not sure.

When can I get one?

ShawtyPop is almost here. Join the waitlist or the Pop Culture newsletter for first dibs on Cherry Gloss and 15% off your first order.

Where do you ship?

We ship within the U.S. only for now, with free shipping on orders over $50. Shipping policy

Can I return my order?

Because ShawtyPop is a food product, all sales are final. If your order arrives damaged or wrong, email us within 7 days and we'll make it right. Returns policy
